sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- When looking at the explosion, is added for 40 seconds, causing a blinding effect that starts to fade out after 20 seconds, as well as a visual impairment which lasts 90 seconds
- Within a 10m radius around the explosion, is added for 20 seconds, causing tinnitus and muffled audio

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Grenade box
- Weapon box (6x2)
- Buried barrel cache
- Ground cache
